description: The Global Tsunami Evacuation Model team publishes an agent-based pedestrian evacuation model. Zenodo provides version 1.0.0 source, configurations, example data and documentation under MIT. Its public repository explains that users supply a road network, population origins and tsunami arrival time; the model reports who reaches safety, where others remain and which streets become congested. The package can compare shelter placement, warning and route choices in coastal emergency-service simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers GTEM. Coverage is user-prepared coastal study areas, not one global, ready-to-run map despite the name. A limitation stated by the authors is that GTEM has not been validated against an observed evacuation and does not predict casualties. It requires NetLogo and a Python environment, which were not installed in this review. Input quality and behavioural assumptions can change the results. No source archive was downloaded and no simulation was run.
